services.name: Thai Yoga Massage
services.desc: An ancient bodywork practice that follows Ayurvedic principles that originate in Asia, the massage occurs on floor mats and fully clothed, Thai massage begins at the feet and ends at the head following energy lines through the body. It blends yoga-style stretching, acupressure, trigger point massage, breath work, and meditation. The massage is excellent for relief of general muscle tension, fatigue, headaches, stress, PMS, and menstrual pain. Massage and movement have been part of Angele's family culture from a young age.
